_comment: shovel_dirt on Unitree H1-2. Same source clip and same GVHMR prediction as the
G1 version; only the retarget target differs. H1-2's grip span is 0.745 m
(G1: 0.438 m) because GMR scales the human motion to the robot, so it needs a
grip_offset is deliberately absent, matching the G1 config: on an open
end-effector it puts the object on a lever arm the robot cannot hold.
H1-2 handless has no rubber-hand bodies, so wrist_yaw_link is the grip frame.
